fields.description: SRAM backup signature; compared against expected string on every load
fields.evidence: FUN_080004e0 reads SRAM 0x0E000000 (size 0x148) into buffer+8 and memcmps 16 bytes at save offset 0 vs expected magic; FUN_080003a0 re-reads the same header on init.
fields.name: backup_magic

fields.description: Record-allocator cursor: word offset of next free SRAM word; advanced by record size on each journal write
fields.evidence: FUN_080003a0 sets buffer+0x18 (= save offset 0x10) from SRAM base; FUN_08000674 reads it as iVar7, writes the record at iVar7*4+base and advances it by uVar8 words before persisting the header with FUN_08000ff0 (SRAM 0x0E000000, size 0x148).
fields.name: alloc_cursor_words

fields.description: Remaining free SRAM words tracked in the header; decremented by each record's word size
fields.evidence: FUN_080003a0 initializes buffer+0x1c (= save offset 0x14); FUN_08000674 decrements it by uVar8 (param_3>>2) on every record write; baseline holds 0x15b0.
fields.name: remaining_words

fields.description: Free game-record slots left in the 64-entry descriptor table; init 0x40, minus one per saved record
fields.evidence: FUN_080003a0 sets buffer+0x1e (= save offset 0x16) to 0x40; FUN_08000674 decrements it per record; FUN_080007e8 scans the 0x40-entry table at buffer+0x44 (= save offset 0x44). Baseline 0x33 = 51 free.
fields.name: free_record_slots

fields.description: Per-file save counter for file 0; incremented on every record save to that file
fields.evidence: FUN_08000674 increments buffer+0x20+param_1 (= save offset 0x18+file) per save; FUN_080008d8 returns that byte for file param_1; baseline file 0 = 1.
fields.name: file_0_save_count

fields.description: Per-file save counter for file 1; incremented on every record save to that file
fields.evidence: FUN_08000674 increments buffer+0x20+param_1 (= save offset 0x18+file) per save; FUN_080008d8 returns that byte for file param_1.
fields.name: file_1_save_count

fields.description: Random nonzero per-file tag for file 0; record descriptors match against it to list a file's records
fields.evidence: FUN_080003a0 generates 10 unique nonzero bytes at buffer+0x38..0x41 (= save offsets 0x30..0x39); FUN_080007e8 lists records whose descriptor tag bits ((*desc & 0x1ff)>>1) equal buffer+0x38+param_1.
fields.name: file_0_tag

fields.description: Random nonzero per-file tag for file 1; record descriptors match against it to list a file's records
fields.evidence: FUN_080003a0 generates 10 unique nonzero bytes at buffer+0x38..0x41 (= save offsets 0x30..0x39); FUN_080007e8 lists records whose descriptor tag bits ((*desc & 0x1ff)>>1) equal buffer+0x38+param_1.
fields.name: file_1_tag

fields.description: Checksum byte over the 10 file-tag bytes: sum mod 256
fields.evidence: FUN_080003a0 sums the 10 bytes at buffer+0x38..0x41 (= save offsets 0x30..0x39) and stores the byte at buffer+0x42 (= save offset 0x3A); verified: sum = 0xa4 matches baseline.
fields.name: file_id_checksum_value

fields.description: First game-record descriptor: bit0 valid, bits1-8 file tag match, offset/size packed; encodes an SRAM record location
fields.evidence: FUN_08000674 packs valid bit, tag byte (buffer+0x38+param_1), SRAM word offset and size into the free slot at buffer+0x44 (= save offset 0x44); FUN_080009c0 decodes offset ((desc & 0x7fffff)>>9)*4 and size (desc>>0x17)<<2 to read the record. Baseline 0x6e0601a5.
fields.name: record_entry_0

fields.description: Header integrity word: sum of 81 LE u32 words over save offsets [0, 0x144)
fields.evidence: FUN_08001144 sums u32 words; FUN_080010d0 checksums 0x144 bytes and FUN_080003a0 stores it at buffer+0x14c (= save offset 0x144); FUN_080010f8 verifies equality on load in FUN_080004e0; verified: sum = 0xb458d2d7 matches baseline.
fields.name: header_checksum_value
